note: recording_detached means the hook calls .detach() inside the hook; the reduction runs on the GPU and only the reduced per-type vectors (65) and the central-cell vector (65) are moved to CPU; activity_mutated=false is asserted in the hook (`state.nodes.activity is x` after the read), not assumed
reduction_device: the activity's own device (GPU); float64 index_add_ on the GPU may sum in a different order than on the CPU, so the last bits can differ. The three-checkpoint outputs of 2026-09-20 in this directory were produced on the CPU path and are SUPERSEDED, not mixed.
determinism_mode: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), cudnn.deterministic=True, cudnn.benchmark=False (A4, --deterministic); outputs carry the _det suffix

env.determinism_note: set by diag1_eval_paths.build_solver:90-93, which reproduces run_individual.py:284-286 under --no-determinism, the flag every night wave ran under (wave_night4.json / wave_night5.json "no_determinism": true) -- and then OVERRIDDEN by --deterministic (A4): use_deterministic_algorithms(True), cudnn.deterministic=True, cudnn.benchmark=False. This is a DIFFERENT instrument from the nights' evaluation path and writes under _det names.

N.N_is_counted_in: individuals; replicate runs of the same seed do NOT enter N

p2prime_threshold_rule.rule: threshold for P2' = 10 x the measured floor of README Sec 6, taken on the SAME reduction path and the SAME determinism mode as the statistic it judges. A computation, not a judgement.

P0_evaluation_without_recording_reproduc.what: the same evaluation with NO hook registered, against the val_loss stored inside the checkpoint file

P1prime_the_recording_hook_does_not_chan.what: the loss with the recording hook registered, against P0. The criterion is ON THE LOSS -- the aggregate the rung reports -- and the per-item figures are recorded beside it, at their own separately named level.
P1prime_the_recording_hook_does_not_chan.tolerance_status: REGISTERED and NOT amended on 2026-09-20; the verdicts it produced on the first run stand
P1prime_the_recording_hook_does_not_chan.abs_diff_level: loss (the per-item mean); this is the level `pass` is taken at
P1prime_the_recording_hook_does_not_chan.abs_diff_loss_nohook_vs_nohook_what: the floor AT THE JUDGED LEVEL: the largest loss-level difference among the K no-hook repeats of the same state (A2, Johnny; confirmed by Ark and Zcode)
P1prime_the_recording_hook_does_not_chan.ulps_level: the ULP figure above is the PER-ITEM level; the loss-level difference is a different and larger number of ULPs and is not the same statistic

floor_nohook_vs_nohook.what: the same state, the same code path, no hook at all, evaluated K+1 times in ONE process; each repeat differenced against the first (P0's reading)
floor_nohook_vs_nohook.note: a within-process floor. The across-process floor of README Sec 6 is a different and larger quantity and is measured by --floor-repeat.

descriptive_hook_diff_le_max_floor.what: is the with-hook difference no larger than the largest of the K no-hook-vs-no-hook differences of the same state? Descriptive only: it does not enter, soften or override the P1' pass/fail above, which is the registered 1e-6 on the loss.
descriptive_hook_diff_le_max_floor.caveat_at_k_1: at --floor-k 1 the floor is a sample of size one and this comparison is a coin toss dressed as a bound

P2prime_the_instrument_sees_something.what: (i) the per-item vectors over the input cell types differ between items; (ii) the 65-vector is not constant
P2prime_the_instrument_sees_something.threshold_source: the measured floor (README Sec 6); NEVER the data being judged
P2prime_the_instrument_sees_something.threshold_rule: threshold for P2' = 10 x the measured floor of README Sec 6, taken on the SAME reduction path and the SAME determinism mode as the statistic it judges. A computation, not a judgement.
P2prime_the_instrument_sees_something.threshold_rule_applied_by: --floor-summarize, which writes the products into rowB_floor[_det].json; this block keeps its nulls until that file exists
